title: Device twin — reported properties
description: DESCRIPTIVE, NOT NORMATIVE. Generated from firmware source at FW 1.8.0 and re-verified field by field against FW 2.1.4 (branch fix/2.1.4, release commit "chore(release): 2.1.4", whose parent is x-nearest-commit). x-source line numbers are from the 1.8.0 generation and are STALE; fields added or changed for 2.1.4 cite functions instead. This is not a specification and not a proposal; it records what the device emits today. Plane: Device twin (NOT D2C telemetry). `required` lists only keys present in the minimal payload, i.e. those always emitted for this message type.

fw_version.description: Hub firmware version, from the build-time PROJECT_VER.

gateway_id.description: GW- prefixed hub identity. Same value as telemetry gateway.id, different key name.

short_id.description: Last 4 hex of the gateway id.

hub_name.description: User-assigned hub name. NOTE: telemetry omits gateway.name when empty; the twin always emits the key.

provisioned.description: The hub's provisioning state; false on a hub with no devices (the twin is published for it too since 2.1.4).

valve_mac.description: ALWAYS null. Deletes the pre-1.8.0 spelling from the twin (a reported PATCH merges).

valve_id.description: The provisioned valve MAC; null when no valve is provisioned (never omitted, so a removed valve is deleted from the twin). Read this key and nothing else.

lora_sensor_count.description: How many LoRa sensors are commissioned.

ble_leak_sensor_count.description: How many BLE leak sensors are commissioned.

auto_close_enabled.description: Whether the hub will close the valve automatically on a leak. OMITTED when the rules config cannot be read.

trigger_mask.description: Bitmask of which leak sources may trigger auto-close. bit0=BLE, bit1=LoRa, bit2=valve flood. OMITTED when the rules config cannot be read.

uptime_s.description: Seconds since boot AT THE MOMENT THE TWIN WAS PATCHED (on connect, on every device-set change, rules_config, set_hub_name and every desired-property delivery). Not a live value.

snapshot_interval_s.description: The heartbeat interval IN FORCE (60-3600 s). Compare with desired.snapshot_interval_s to confirm a write was accepted (since 2.0.2).

free_heap.description: Free heap in bytes. The ONLY hub diagnostic that exists on the twin and nowhere in telemetry.
